top_signals.title: Singapore tightens monetary policy in surprise move as rising oil prices rekindle inflation risk
top_signals.summary: Unlike most central banks, the MAS manages medium-term price stability by managing the Singapore dollar exchange rate against a trade-weighted basket of currencies.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.
